requirements.title: Account Initialization and Non-Negative Balance Enforcement
requirements.description: An account must be created with non-negative initial balance; negative balances raise InvalidAmountError.

acceptance_criteria.description: Initial balance >= 0 succeeds and sets balance accurately.
Initial balance < 0 raises InvalidAmountError and prevents account creation.

requirements.title: Positive Transfer Amount Validation
requirements.description: Transfer amounts <= 0 must be rejected with InvalidAmountError without mutating balances.

requirements.title: Successful Balance Transfer
requirements.description: When transfer amount <= sender balance, sender is debited, recipient is credited, and total funds are conserved.

acceptance_criteria.description: Sender debited by amount, recipient credited by exact amount.
Conservation of total balances across accounts.

requirements.title: Overdraft Prevention and Atomic Balance Preservation
requirements.description: When a transfer amount exceeds sender available balance, transfer must be rejected and neither balance may change.

acceptance_criteria.description: Transfer attempt exceeding available balance raises InsufficientFundsError.
Sender balance strictly remains at initial level (₹10,000 in baseline).
Recipient balance strictly remains at initial level (₹0 in baseline).
Operation is atomic; zero partial mutation allowed.

requirements.title: Prohibition of Self-Transfers
requirements.description: An account cannot initiate a transfer to itself; raises SelfTransferError.

requirements.title: Dual-Authorization for High-Value Corporate Transfers
requirements.description: Transfers exceeding ₹1,000,000 require secondary managerial authorization.
